source_provenance.prompt: A new photograph using exactly the six plasticine figures from <ref_image_0>, the same chunky rounded style, colours, faces and props, and no other figures. A tall handmade wooden marble run zig-zags down the right half of the frame, its painted tracks of tomato red, mint and white splitting into three lanes and funnelling back together, with small red-and-white level-crossing barriers along the way. A single clear glass marble shines at the very top, about to roll. The six figures stand one at each little station along the track, watching the marble: navy with clipboard at the top funnel, mint with magnifying glass, yellow with paintbrush, orange with hammer, white in navy overalls with wrench, red with pennant near the bottom. Exactly six figures in total. The left half of the frame is the clean, empty sunflower-yellow painted wall, space for a headline. Handmade claymation diorama photograph, soft diffused studio light, gentle shadows, tilt-shift miniature look, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
